## 🛠️ Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Laptop Component & Chip-Level Motherboard Repair
- Advanced BGA rework, power IC short circuit troubleshooting, MOSFET replacement, liquid spill / moisture damage recovery.
- Same-day replacement of broken FHD, IPS, 144Hz/240Hz Gaming, and OLED screens.
- OEM battery replacement, charging port / jack repair, and certified charger adapters.
- Laptop hinge repair, body fabrication, brass nut fixing, thermal repasting with high-grade Arctic MX-4 compound.

### 2. Apple MacBook & iMac Specialist Service Center
- MacBook Air & MacBook Pro M1, M2, M3, M4 and Intel logic board chip-level micro-soldering.
- Liquid-damaged MacBook restoration, Retina display replacement, butterfly / scissor keyboard replacement, trackpad calibration.
- macOS upgrade, time machine backup restore, and high-speed NVMe upgrades.

### 3. Desktop Computer & Custom Gaming PC Rigs
- Desktop SMPS power supply diagnosis, motherboard repair, CPU upgrade, and BIOS flashing.
- Custom gaming desktop PC assembly, RGB liquid cooling loop installation, cable management, GPU thermal pad replacement.
- High-speed DDR4 / DDR5 RAM upgrades and Gen 4 NVMe M.2 SSD installations.

### 4. Printer Repair & Eco-Friendly Toner Refill
- HP, Canon, Epson, and Brother LaserJet & InkTank printer head cleaning, roller replacement, and logic board servicing.
- On-site low-cost toner cartridge refilling and original cartridge delivery.

### 5. CCTV Security Surveillance & Biometrics
- Hikvision, CP PLUS, and Dahua HD Night Vision IP camera wiring, DVR/NVR setup, and remote mobile viewing on smartphone.
- Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) for commercial offices, factories, hospitals, and residential societies.

### 6. Clean-Room Hard Drive & SSD Data Recovery
- Mechanical hard disk head crash, spindle motor failure, formatted partition, and deleted file recovery.
- Corrupted USB pen drive, SD card, NAS RAID array, and ransomware-encrypted storage recovery.

### 7. Corporate IT AMC & Networking Infrastructure
- Structured Cat6 LAN cabling, Gigabit switches, enterprise mesh Wi-Fi setup, server racks, and firewall configuration.
- Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) for SMEs, clinics, schools, and corporate offices in Nagpur.

### 8. Tally Multi-User LAN, Enterprise Software & Quick Heal Security
- Tally Prime Multi-User LAN networking (connecting 2 to 10+ office PCs to central server) with automated cloud/local backup sync.
- Genuine Windows 11 Pro, Microsoft Office 365 licensing, and Quick Heal Total Security / Endpoint Antivirus deployment.

### 9. Smart Home Retrofit, Biometric Door Locks & Touch Glass Switches
- Zero-rewiring Smart Home & Office Retrofit modules with mobile app and voice control.
- Biometric fingerprint & facial recognition attendance machines, smart digital door locks, and touch glass switch panels.
